task.title: Troubleshooting Red Hat Quay authentication and authorization issues for specific users
task.shortdesc: To troubleshoot Red Hat Quay authentication and authorization issues for specific users, you can exec into the Red Hat Quay pod or container and query the federatedlogin and user tables to verify user records.
